name: Recova – Safe Recovery Mode Login
author: Umar Jameel

sections.description:
Recova – Safe Recovery Mode Login provides administrators with a recovery login option when a WordPress website encounters a critical PHP error and becomes inaccessible through the normal WordPress login process.

The plugin displays a recovery screen that allows an administrator to enter a configured recovery password and access the site in Safe Recovery Mode. Administrators can also request a temporary, single-use recovery URL to be sent to the WordPress administrator email address.

Recova also displays relevant error information on the recovery screen to help administrators identify the cause of the problem and safely access the site for troubleshooting.

Features

  • Safe Recovery Mode login for administrators
  • Recovery password configuration from the WordPress admin area
  • Temporary, single-use recovery URL sent to the WordPress administrator email address
  • Recovery screen displayed when a critical PHP error prevents normal access
  • Error information displayed on the recovery screen for troubleshooting
  • Simple interface for configuring recovery settings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Safe Mode Login in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure the Safe Recovery Mode password and other available settings.
sections.faq:
What happens when my website encounters a critical PHP error?

If a critical PHP error prevents the website from loading normally, Recova can display a recovery screen instead of the standard error screen. The recovery screen provides the administrator with access to Safe Recovery Mode and displays available error information for troubleshooting.

How can I access Safe Recovery Mode?

You can access Safe Recovery Mode by entering the recovery password configured in the plugin. Depending on the available recovery options, you can also request a temporary recovery URL to be sent to the WordPress administrator email address.

Where can I manage the recovery password settings?

You can manage the recovery password and other plugin settings from the Safe Mode Login menu in the WordPress admin dashboard.

Where is the recovery email sent?

The recovery URL is sent to the email address configured as the WordPress Administration Email Address.
